breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt provided two conflicting time integration methods: 'Explicit forward Euler' and a 'Semi-implicit' scheme. The ground truth removed the explicit Euler method, keeping only the semi-implicit one. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated instructions exclusively for the semi-implicit scheme, as shown by the instruction to 'Form the linear system (I – dt·ε²·L) u^{n+1} = u^n + dt·f^n and solve for u^{n+1} using a sparse linear solver', which perfectly matches the ground truth's requirement.
